title: Gym
description: Guided strength sessions from a versioned training plan: today's day, a block timer, sets with reps, weight and RIR, rests, alternatives, a calendar of workouts and a muscle-recovery map.
whenToUse: Strength training: today's workout, a guided gym session, sets and weights, muscle recovery.
name: Gym
usage: Strength training. «Let's train» is `start_session` (today's day of the plan); during it «done» is `set_done` (say reps/weight if different), «next»/«start now» is `next`, «skip it» is `skip_exercise`, «another exercise» is `suggest_alternative` then `use_alternative`, «I'm done» is `finish` (or `end_early` before the last block). A workout done elsewhere is `log_workout` with its exercises and sets.

select_program.desc: Choose the training program to follow; the first choice (or a different program) opens a new version of the plan.

configure.desc: Set the gym's equipment, the free-text preferences the trainer must respect (style, exercises to avoid) and the person's age (for heart-rate zones).
configure.how: equipment: a list of what the gym has among dumbbells, barbells, squat_rack, adjustable_bench, leg_machines, cables, cardio, functional, pullup_bar (or an object of booleans); only the fields he names change

open_view.desc: Show a screen of the gym app: home, preview (today's workout before starting), calendar, muscles (recovery map), config, planner, program, summary of a session, exercise history, log.

start_session.desc: Start the guided session of today's workout (the plan's day), or of another day of the program; an unfinished session resumes instead.
start_session.how: `day` only when he names another day of the program (push, legs, back, fullbody, upper-heavy)

set_values.desc: Change the weight, reps or RIR shown for the current set before it is done.

set_done.desc: Record the current set as done (with the weight and reps on screen, or the ones he says) and start the rest or the next exercise.
set_done.how: pass `reps`, `weight_kg` or `rir` only when he says them; otherwise the values on screen are used

next.desc: Start now: end the current rest, or leave the running timed block (warm-up, stretch, transition) for the next one.

undo_set.desc: Undo the last recorded set of the session and go back to it.

skip_exercise.desc: Skip the current exercise or block; it is recorded as not done and the session moves on.

pause_timer.desc: Pause the running timer (rest or timed block).

adjust_rest.desc: Add or take seconds from the running timer (rest or timed block).

suggest_alternative.desc: Show a substitute for the current exercise or cardio block; asked again, it shows another one.

use_alternative.desc: Replace the current block with the alternative on screen.

close_alternatives.desc: Close the alternatives without changing the exercise.

end_early.desc: End the session now and keep what was done as a partial workout.

abort.desc: Discard the whole session in progress and every set recorded in it.
abort.confirm_q: Discard the whole workout in progress and its sets? This cannot be undone.

delete_session.desc: Delete one recorded workout and its sets.
delete_session.confirm_q: Delete the workout «{item}» and its sets? This cannot be undone.

delete_day.desc: Delete every workout recorded on a date.
delete_day.confirm_q: Delete every workout of that day? This cannot be undone.

log_workout.desc: Record a workout done without the guided session: its date, day and exercises with their sets.
log_workout.how: exercises: [{name, sets:[{reps, weight_kg}]}] or the short form {name, sets: 4, reps: 10, weight_kg: 20}; date YYYY-MM-DD («yesterday» resolved), default today; day_key the main group (push, pull, back, legs, fullbody, upper-heavy)

edit_session.desc: Correct a recorded workout: change, add or delete sets or exercises, named E1, E2… (and E1.1 for a set) as on its summary.
edit_session.how: ops: [{op: replace_exercise|delete_exercise|edit_set|delete_set|add_set|add_exercise, exercise_index (1 = E1), set_index (0-based), reps, weight_kg, name, sets:[{reps, weight_kg}]}]

adjust_today.desc: Ask the trainer to reshape today's workout from an instruction (shorter, other muscle groups).

refresh_plan.desc: Ask the trainer for the plan of the next days from the recent workouts and recovery.

claim.desc: The screen that drives the session claims it: it reads the heart-rate strap, beeps and keeps the screen awake (sent by the app itself).

timer_done.desc: A screen saw the timer reach zero for the block and set it shows (sent by the app itself).

hr.desc: The latest heart rate from the strap of the screen that drives the session (sent by the app itself).
